title: A Frank De Vol picture call for MGM
summary: He cannot recall the film title but remembers playing tuba in a brass band on "California, Here I Come".

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: Do you the name of the picture that this was for?
Not really. All I remember is it's for MGM. It hasn't come out yet. It should be easy enough to find out the name. I'll let you know next time.
Yeah, we could have that on the tape for reference purposes.
Yeah. So it's Frank De Vol for MGM. I do remember one thing we did where I played tuba in a big brass band part, and we did "California, Here I Come." I can't
remember who the stars were, but that will come, too, when I stop and think about it. But "California, Here I Come" seemed to be one of the big things about it.
